text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute ran a strong race despite 
being exhausted. Meanwhile, Smart Falcon 
was waving to the spectators with a bright 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute didn't have that kind of 
leeway. Even so, she felt like she finally 
caught sight of her goal's back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prove she had fully caught up, she 
wanted to run with her at least one more 
time. After spending a relaxing New Year's 
holiday, she decided to enter the Kawasaki 
Kinen.
